discussions.description: User discussions on specific Ayahs or global discussions

fields.author: string - Name of the user (e.g., 'Anonymous')
fields.email: string | null - Email of the user
fields.surahNumber: number | null - Surah number if specific to an Ayah
fields.ayahNumber: number | null - Ayah number if specific to an Ayah
fields.surahName: string | null - Name of the Surah
fields.replyToId: string | null - ID of the discussion being replied to
fields.createdAt: timestamp - When the discussion was posted
